plugin.name: MaaEnd Executor
plugin.description: Ships the MaaEnd self-built executor and its asset layer (Arknights: Endfield automation) so neko-chan can run tasks and narrate progress.
ui.title: MaaEnd executor
ui.stopHint: "Stop task" only stops what the executor is running; once stopped, its outcome is no longer announced.
ui.manualLaunchHint: You can also double-click {path} to start it by hand (it requests administrator rights).
ui.disconnectedHint: The control panel backend is not running. "Start executor" raises a UAC prompt to bring it up.
ui.notAdmin: The executor is not running as administrator, so the keystrokes it sends to the game go nowhere and the task is guaranteed to fail. Restart it with "Start executor" or start_panel.bat.
ui.badResolutionHint: The resolution is not 16:9, and the executor stops the task outright at any other ratio. Set the game to 16:9 first.
ui.noOptions: This task has nothing to configure.
ui.unsupportedOption: This plugin does not know the option type {type}, so it was not rendered.
ui.noShotHint: Press "Grab one" to capture the current game frame.
ui.noAssetPack: No game asset layer is installed, so the executor cannot run anything: {problems}
